Fixture for scripts/test-check-public-wording.sh. These lines sit close to a barred term
without using one, so the word-boundary match must leave them alone. No line may be reported.

- Immutability of container image tags is covered in the deployment guide.
- The service appends only the fields it validated.
- Tamper detection and proof of possession are separate topics.
- Evidence of tampering is reported to the administrator.
- A record cannot be edited, or deleted without approval, by a member.
- Agents sign requests; the server does not claim repudiation protection.
